id.description: The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event.

ts.description: When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced.

workspace_id.description: A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID.

space_id.description: The space, when the event belongs to one.

run_id.description: The run, when the event belongs to one.

seq.description: Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in.

idempotency_key.description: Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op.

kind.description: Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted.

id.description: The participant id, or `system` for Chips.

harness_id.description: For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips.

actor.description: The participant an event is attributed to.

model.description: The model that did the work.

input_tokens.description: Tokens in: every token the model read, fresh, read from its prompt cache and written to it. Leave it out when the harness cannot say: the tokens out are still counted, and Chips puts no price on a report it cannot count whole.

cache_read_tokens.description: Of the tokens in, how many the model read from its prompt cache. Leave it out when the harness cannot say or the model keeps no cache.

cache_write_tokens.description: Of the tokens in, how many the model wrote to its prompt cache. Leave it out when the harness cannot say or the model keeps no cache.

output_tokens.description: Tokens out. Leave it out when the harness cannot say, and send the cost: Chips prices only a report whose tokens it has whole.

cost.description: The estimated cost, when the harness can compute one.

estimated.description: Always true. Cost is never presented as exact.

description: Tokens and cost for a step, a run or a lane. Cost rolls up the trail and is always an estimate.
